title: Giving a Good Speech
text:
Public speaking can make many people feel nervous. Before a speech, a good speaker prepares notes and practises the main points several times. Some speakers also visit the room in advance to check the microphone and the screen. These small steps help the speaker feel more calm on the day.

During the speech, a good speaker looks at the audience and speaks slowly. Eye contact shows that the speaker is confident and interested in the listeners. Speakers often use simple examples to explain difficult ideas. At the end, a clear summary helps the audience remember the main message.

questions.text: According to the passage, what do some speakers do in advance?
options: Visit the room to check the microphone and screen
Change the topic of the speech

questions.text: According to the passage, what does eye contact show?
options: That the speech is too long
That the audience is not listening
That the speaker is confident and interested in the listeners

questions.text: What can the reader infer about a speaker who speaks slowly and uses simple examples?
options: They want the audience to understand
They do not know the topic

questions.text: What can the reader infer about a speaker who ends with a clear summary?
options: They plan to leave the room early
They are not sure of their ideas
They want the audience to speak first
They want the audience to remember the main message

vocabulary.definition: worried or anxious about something that is going to happen
does something again and again in order to get better at it
sure of your own abilities and ideas
a short statement of the main points of something

paragraph_translations: Halka önünde konuşmak birçok insanı gergin hissettirebilir. Bir konuşmadan önce iyi bir konuşmacı notlarını hazırlar ve ana noktaları birkaç kez pratik yapar. Bazı konuşmacılar ayrıca mikrofonu ve ekranı kontrol etmek için salonu önceden ziyaret eder. Bu küçük adımlar konuşmacının o gün daha sakin hissetmesine yardımcı olur.

Konuşma sırasında iyi bir konuşmacı dinleyicilere bakar ve yavaş konuşur. Göz teması, konuşmacının özgüvenli olduğunu ve dinleyicilerle ilgilendiğini gösterir. Konuşmacılar zor fikirleri açıklamak için sık sık basit örnekler kullanır. Sonunda net bir özet, dinleyicilerin ana mesajı hatırlamasına yardımcı olur.
